unitGuard.reason: Withheld: the EPS row reads 341 for FY2025, the OPPOSITE sign to the net profit reported for the same period (-8.74657e+08), and its magnitude is 3119x that period's net profit divided by the shares on file (-0.109332) - a figure of a different order, not a share-count basis difference. The inputs on file do not recover the printed per-share figure, so nothing is published for this period. A blank is honest; a per-share figure whose sign contradicts its own period's earnings is not.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed
